To use a Steam beta code for a game, follow these steps:
Open Steam and go to your Library.
Right-click on the game and select Properties.
Navigate to the Betas tab.
Enter the beta access code in the box labeled "Enter beta access code to unlock private betas".
Click Check Code.
If the code is valid, a new beta branch will appear in the dropdown menu—select it to install the beta version.

notes.title: Update 0.2.23
notes.notes:
- added new weapon: Execution Post
- Execution Post can chop NPC in half
- Execution Post can cut NPC legs
- Execution Post can behead NPC
- Execution Post can burn NPC
- Execution Post can lingchi NPC
- Execution Post can toggle transparency
- Barehanded NPCs can do damage
- desktop player press "5" to become a cheerleader/dance
- when in cheerleader mode, desktop player can press down arrow to cheer
- when in cheerleader mode, desktop player can click left mouse to cheer
- when in cheerleader mode, desktop player can click right mouse to dance
